_doc: Submission configuration (compliance revision 16/11): the 0.952 framework (S = Qwen3.5-9B + V3A x 0.70; W1 rule cards / shop functions written by the model at run time from the split's own rulebook and data; W3 judge WJR1) with nothing derived from a test split: no precomputed cards of any test split (the model writes them for every new rulebook, public and private alike) and no question linker (WL1 removed). Every adapter is trained on the organisers' training split only. known_rb train: only the training rulebook counts as known; every other row of the split's rulebook is the split's own rule (prompt + W1 functions). unit_ex_style neutral: the W1 function writer's examples use invented rulebook rows. + general consistency layer (src/consistency.py): a sample whose program ignores a period / threshold the question states counts half in the vote; len() of a mask is a repair error. + general Vietnamese retail / service glossary (src/refs/lrl/glossary_vi.jsonl, training/data/build_glossary.py): word-meaning cards matched by the question's words. + hide_api industry: no hand-written industry toolkit (its definitions follow one rulebook); the model writes the shop functions of every industry row of the split's own rulebook (W1).
